intended_behavior: Implement a new middleware subclassing MiddlewareBase. Override async on_reasoning to sum token usage from agent.state.context messages' usage attribute (input_tokens + output_tokens). When total tokens exceed max_tokens, inject a predefined hint message instructing the agent to immediately stop invoking tools and provide a final concluding response. Follow the async generator middleware pattern to yield events and call next_handler accordingly, preserving existing middleware integration and functionality.
